home.why.title: Why Sahla?
home.why.sub: Sahla means “easy” in Moroccan Arabic. Our job is to make Morocco easy to understand, with information you can check.
home.why.1.title: Practical information
home.why.1.text: Prices, steps, timings and documents: what you need to act, without padding.
home.why.2.title: Verifiable sources
home.why.2.text: Sensitive guides point to the relevant official body so you can check every rule.
home.why.3.title: Updated content
home.why.3.text: Each guide shows its update date, and figures that change are dated.
home.why.4.title: Built for MREs and travellers
home.why.4.text: Two audiences, two paths: going home for the summer or discovering the country.
home.popularSub: The questions we are asked most often.
home.cities.title: Morocco, city by city
home.cities.sub: Eight cities, eight very different lives. Open a city for transport, neighbourhoods, budget and trips.

home.checklists.text: Tick, save on your device and print: summer return, paperwork, property tax, moving back for good…
